PRODUCT_TANKER_TONMILES.label: Product tanker ton-miles

The other source documents two tankers carrying Russian diesel reaching Brazil after bypassing the U.S., demonstrating that refined‑product cargoes are traveling longer distances. No direct ton‑mile data is provided, but the evidence supports the hypothesis that refined‑product cargoes are moving farther and that fleet supply is tightening.
